news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.3% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Shareholders have been substantially diluted in the past year (100% increase in shares outstanding). news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.05 (vs ₹0.015 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.05 (up from ₹0.015 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹69.3m (down 55% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹3.65m (up ₹3.12m from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 5.3% (up from 0.3% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by lower expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 57 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.05 loss per share (vs ₹0.13 profit in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: ₹0.05 loss per share (down from ₹0.13 profit in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹115.3m (up 2.1% from 2Q 2025). Net loss: ₹3.31m (down 171% from profit in 2Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 34% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 2% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
